description: Replace a DNS record (name, content, ttl, priority/weight/port). The record type cannot change: delete the record and create a new one instead. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

confirm.description: Must be true to apply the change.

content.description: Record value (IP address, hostname, TXT text, ...).

name.description: Record name relative to the domain: '@' (default) for the domain itself, 'www', '_acme-challenge', ...

name: update_domain_dns_record
title: Update Domain DNS Record
